role: four pillars (saju, BaZi) of a solar birth date: year pillar from Ipchun, month pillar from the solar terms, day pillar, hour pillar only with birth_hour (Korea standard time, no true-solar-time correction); and today's day pillar (iljin)

year_pillar.pattern: ^[A-Z][a-z]+-[a-z]+ [甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸][子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥]$

month_pillar.pattern: ^[A-Z][a-z]+-[a-z]+ [甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸][子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥]$

day_pillar.pattern: ^[A-Z][a-z]+-[a-z]+ [甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸][子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥]$

anyOf.pattern: ^[A-Z][a-z]+-[a-z]+ [甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸][子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥]$

today_day_pillar.pattern: ^[A-Z][a-z]+-[a-z]+ [甲乙丙丁戊己庚辛壬癸][子丑寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥]$

rules: answer and source are required, as in every contract; the structured fields are optional (an outside member may answer in text; the normalizer reads both), and our own substitute fills them all
pillars are written as romanized Korean and hanzi, e.g. "Gap-ja 甲子"
the year pillar changes at Ipchun (立春) and the month pillar at each solar term (節氣), not at lunar new year or lunar month starts
without birth_hour, hour_pillar is null and basis says "no hour pillar" (three pillars, six characters)
basis names the time standard: Korea standard time, no true-solar-time correction
read-only calculation; no account, payment or write; the birth date is used for the calculation only and never stored or logged
boundary_note, when given, says that Ipchun or a solar term falls on the birth date and how the pillar was decided
